name: Kings County, CA
findings: Kings County has 240 nonprofit organizations. 100 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kings County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 23 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 11 hobby and sports organizations here list public events, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do hobby and sports organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
